works.title: The Canons: First Council of Nicaea (325)
works.author: Nicaea I
works.about: The first ecumenical council: the Creed against Arius, the date of Pascha, and twenty canons on church order.

works.title: The Canons: First Council of Constantinople (381)
works.author: Constantinople I
works.about: The second ecumenical council, which completed the Creed on the Holy Spirit; its canons.

works.title: The Canons: Council of Ephesus (431)
works.author: Ephesus
works.about: The third ecumenical council: the Virgin Mary is Theotokos; Cyril's twelve anathematisms and the council's canons.

works.title: The Canons: Council of Chalcedon (451)
works.author: Chalcedon
works.about: The fourth ecumenical council: Christ one person in two natures; thirty canons, the twenty-eighth on Constantinople.

works.title: The Canons: Second Council of Constantinople (553)
works.author: Constantinople II
works.about: The fifth ecumenical council issued no disciplinary canons: its fourteen anathemas (the Three Chapters) are here.

works.title: The Canons: Third Council of Constantinople (680–681)
works.author: Constantinople III
works.about: The sixth ecumenical council: Christ has two wills and two energies. It made no canons; Trullo (692) supplied them.

works.title: The Canons: Council in Trullo (Quinisext, 692)
works.author: Trullo
works.about: The canons the Orthodox Church counts as those of the fifth and sixth councils, made in 692.

works.title: The Canons: Second Council of Nicaea (787)
chapters: The Decree on the holy icons
works.author: Nicaea II
works.about: The seventh ecumenical council: the veneration of the holy icons restored, and twenty-two canons.

works.title: The Canons: Canons of the Local Synods (Ancyra, Gangra, Neocaesarea, Antioch, Laodicea)
works.author: Local synods
works.about: Canons of fourth-century local synods, received by the ecumenical councils and kept in the Orthodox canon law.
